AdaptationCell.description: One (entry, task, condition, budget, seed): a run and what it produced, or why there is no number.
AdaptationCell.title: AdaptationCell

AdaptationEntry.description: A method: a PA model, or a DPD model that goes through the PA entry's model of the same condition and seed.
AdaptationEntry.title: AdaptationEntry

AdaptationPlan.description: Pre-registered: ``plan_sha256`` covers everything but ``created_at`` and itself.
AdaptationPlan.title: AdaptationPlan

AdaptationReportSummary.description: One row of the reports list: enough to pick a report, never a number to compare.
AdaptationReportSummary.title: AdaptationReportSummary

AlignmentDiagnostic.description: An ablation on the same retained samples; these are diagnostics, not profile metrics.
AlignmentDiagnostic.title: AlignmentDiagnostic

BaselineScore.description:
Scores of a comparison signal under the *same* reference, profile and
valid range as ``EvaluationResult.metrics``; never normalised separately.
A measured baseline is a second capture: it carries its own alignment (delay
and least-squares gain, both recorded in the measurement) and the level
difference between the captures is reported, never scaled away.
BaselineScore.title: BaselineScore

CaptureAlignment.description: How one capture was aligned to the signal that was played, in capture units.
CaptureAlignment.title: CaptureAlignment

CaptureRef.description: A capture file under ``<workspace>/imports`` (an upload or a copied file); never an arbitrary path.
CaptureRef.title: CaptureRef

ComparisonReport.description:
Results shown side by side. ``comparable`` is True only when every pair was produced under the same
protocol (``opendpd.core.metrics.incompatibilities``); otherwise the reasons are listed and nothing is ranked.
ComparisonReport.title: ComparisonReport

Condition.description: One operating condition = one registered dataset from its own capture.
Condition.title: Condition

ConditionAudit.description: What the workspace says about a condition's dataset at report time (the card holds the rest).
ConditionAudit.title: ConditionAudit

ConditionSet.description: The data card. ``card_sha256`` covers everything but ``created_at`` and itself.

held_out_policy.default: roles are declared in the card before any run; target conditions are never used to select hyper-parameters, and every number is read from the target's test split after the run finished
held_out_policy.title: Held Out Policy

ConditionSet.title: ConditionSet

DatasetVersion.description:
One materialised data version (raw-v1 or a preprocessing result), in the
directory layout the trainer reads (split CSV files).
DatasetVersion.title: DatasetVersion

EvidenceBar.description: Whether the card meets the S17 evidence bar; a report below the bar is a rehearsal, not evidence.
EvidenceBar.title: EvidenceBar

EvidenceType.description: What kind of evidence a result represents. Never inferred, always declared.
EvidenceType.title: EvidenceType

ExecutionEvidence.description:
How the evaluated model consumed the signal (plan S18). Present for streaming variants only; offline
results are segment-wise from a zero state and say so through ``ModelEvidence.execution_semantics``.
ExecutionEvidence.title: ExecutionEvidence

FileRef.description:
A file inside a known container (workspace, run or dataset directory).
Paths are relative POSIX paths; absolute paths and ``..`` are rejected so
a manifest can never point outside its container.
FileRef.title: FileRef

FixedPointReport.description: Every number labelled by how it was obtained; the labels never mix.
FixedPointReport.title: FixedPointReport

FixedPointSpec.description: Every format and rule of the GRU fixed-point reference. Changing any of them is a new spec id.

nonlinearity.default: table lookup without interpolation: index = saturate(round(pre-activation to LUT_FRAC)) + offset
nonlinearity.title: Nonlinearity

rounding.default: round half up: add 2^(s-1) then arithmetic shift right by s; left shifts are exact
rounding.title: Rounding

saturation.default: every stored quantity saturates to its word width (x, h, y, gate values, table index); the accumulator never wraps
saturation.title: Saturation

FixedPointSpec.title: FixedPointSpec

GoldenCase.description: One golden vector: inputs, expected outputs and final state, all in the spec's integer formats.
GoldenCase.title: GoldenCase

HistoryPoint.description: One split's metrics after one epoch, read from the run's history log (same shape as ``metric`` events).
HistoryPoint.title: HistoryPoint

InitReference.description: Warm start (S17): the weights of a succeeded run of the same task and model start this training.
InitReference.title: InitReference

LineageRelation.description: How one run depends on another. Recorded from resolved configurations, never inferred from names.
LineageRelation.title: LineageRelation

MeasuredExecution.description: The C reference's speed on the machine that built the package: a property of that build, not of a deployment.
MeasuredExecution.title: MeasuredExecution

MeasurementConditions.description: What the operator declares about the set-up. Recorded verbatim, never inferred.
MeasurementConditions.title: MeasurementConditions

MeasurementConfig.description: The ``evaluate_measured`` task: which exported signal was played and what came back.
MeasurementConfig.title: MeasurementConfig

MeasurementEvidence.description: Stored as ``measurement.json`` in the run and embedded in every result of the run.
MeasurementEvidence.title: MeasurementEvidence

MetricValue.description:
One formal metric. ``value`` is only present when ``status`` is ``ok``
and is always finite; every other status carries a reason. This is how
"null / not applicable / failed / infinite" get explicit meanings and how
zero-filling of missing metrics is made impossible.
MetricValue.title: MetricValue

ModelInfo.description: Registry descriptor as seen by clients (opendpd.core.registry.ModelDescriptor).
ModelInfo.title: ModelInfo

PAReference.description: The frozen PA surrogate a DPD task trains or evaluates through.
PAReference.title: PAReference

PackageFile.description: A member of the archive; the hash is verified before anything is imported.
PackageFile.title: PackageFile

PackageReference.description: Another run this one depends on (PA surrogate, DPD model); it always travels under refs/ with its checkpoint.
PackageReference.title: PackageReference

display_name.default: Virtual PA · paired input and output
display_name.title: Display Name

ProfileValidation.description:
How a profile's numbers have been checked. The GUI offers only profiles past ``pending_cross_validation``;
the CLI and the API compute every profile and say which status it has.
ProfileValidation.title: ProfileValidation

ResolvedExperimentConfig.description:
Same shape as ``ExperimentConfig`` but every result-affecting default is
explicit, model parameters are complete, and the checkpoint selection
metric is set. Produced only by ``opendpd.services.config.resolve``.
ResolvedExperimentConfig.title: ResolvedExperimentConfig

ResourceEstimate.description: Numbers derived from the specification and the shapes; nothing here was measured.

sparsity.default: none exploited: every MAC is executed
sparsity.title: Sparsity

ResourceEstimate.title: ResourceEstimate

RunEvent.description:
Append-only, strictly increasing ``seq`` per run. Clients resume from
the last ``seq`` they saw; when the server can no longer replay from that
point it answers with a snapshot requirement instead of guessing.
RunEvent.title: RunEvent

RunLineage.description: The experiment graph around one run: what it used (parents) and what used it (children).
RunLineage.title: RunLineage

ScalingInfo.description:
What the amplitudes are relative to. Without a physical calibration no
absolute power (dBm) or efficiency is derived from them.
ScalingInfo.title: ScalingInfo

SignalReference.description: What the evaluated signal was compared against.
SignalReference.title: SignalReference

SignalSpec.description:
Signal metadata needed by evaluation profiles. Unknown values stay
``None``; they are never guessed. ``missing_for_legacy_evaluation`` names
what the legacy profile still needs.
SignalSpec.title: SignalSpec

SignalStage.description:
One link of the evaluated signal chain: ``x`` (target input), ``u = DPD(x)``
(pre-distorted PA input) and ``y`` (PA output). ``simulated`` is True when a
learned surrogate produced the signal; it is never inferred from the task.
SignalStage.title: SignalStage

SourceRef.description: A file inside an authorised import root; clients never send absolute paths.
SourceRef.title: SourceRef

SplitSpec.description:
Contiguous train/val/test split performed *before* framing, with an
optional guard band so overlapping frames never straddle a boundary.
SplitSpec.title: SplitSpec

StreamConsistency.description: Max |streamed - full sequence| of the same variant run from the same reset, over the valid range (streaming-v1).
StreamConsistency.title: StreamConsistency

SurrogateCoverage.description:
How far the pre-distorted signal leaves the amplitude range the PA
surrogate was fitted on. Evidence for an extrapolation warning only: staying
inside the range does not prove the surrogate valid.
SurrogateCoverage.title: SurrogateCoverage

TableSpec.description: A non-linearity as a table: entries at every 2^-frac over [-range, range), values in ``value`` format.
TableSpec.title: TableSpec

TargetRule.description: What 'reaching the target' means: one metric of the plan's profile against a threshold.
TargetRule.title: TargetRule

TensorFormat.description: How one weight tensor was quantised: its fraction and the range it had to hold.
TensorFormat.title: TensorFormat

TrainingConfig.description:
Defaults mirror the Studio full-training preset (arguments.py); they are the
single source of defaults for every entry point.
TrainingConfig.title: TrainingConfig

Verification.description: Bit-exact comparison of the target implementation with the software reference on every golden vector.
Verification.title: Verification

WaveformBinding.description:
A dataset's link to the waveform its input column was captured from.

``input_offset_samples`` is the position of the dataset's first raw input sample inside one period of the
waveform (instruments play a waveform in a loop); ``correlation`` is the normalised cross-correlation peak
that established it. The binding never replaces the captured data: it only says which symbols were sent.
WaveformBinding.title: WaveformBinding

WaveformSpec.description: Everything needed to regenerate a reference waveform bit for bit.
WaveformSpec.title: WaveformSpec

WorkerInfo.description:
Identity of the worker process. PID alone is never trusted: the
process creation time must match too (PIDs are recycled).
WorkerInfo.title: WorkerInfo

WorkspaceSettings.description: Stored as ``<workspace>/settings.json``; ``language`` None uses the English UI default.
WorkspaceSettings.title: WorkspaceSettings

get.description: Hash-bound adaptation reports stored under <workspace>/adaptation/ (built by `opendpd adaptation report`).

schema.title: Response Adaptation Reports Api V1 Adaptation Reports Get

get.description: One report by its plan hash (the first 12 characters suffice); `format=md` downloads the Markdown rendering.
Download by *registered id* only; paths are never accepted from clients.

post.description:
Quantise a finished GRU run under fixed-point-v1, write golden vectors and the C99 reference, verify it bit for
bit, and serve the package from <workspace>/exports. Unsupported models are refused with the reason.
Resolve and bind without starting anything; config problems are data, not 4xx.

post.description: Write an experiment package into <workspace>/exports. `share` leaves user data, logs and machine paths out.

schema.title: Response Figures List Api V1 Figures Get

post.description: Upload an experiment package and import it; every hash is verified before anything is written.

schema.title: Response Metric Profiles Api V1 Metrics Profiles Get

Response Models Api V1 Pa Library Models Get
Response Recipes Api V1 Recipes Get

get.description:
Stored results side by side with the protocol differences that forbid ranking. `format=csv` returns the
same numbers with their provenance rows; nothing is recomputed.
Metric profiles under which this run has a stored result (primary first).

schema.title: Response Results Profiles Api V1 Results  Run Id  Profiles Get

get.description: A report bound to the stored result and plot data (nothing recomputed), for download.
One page of runs, newest first; ``q`` is a case-insensitive substring search over id, name, dataset and model.

schema.title: Response Runs List Api V1 Runs Get

get.description: How many runs match the same filters as the listing (for paging).
Server-Sent Events: ``id`` is the event seq; ``event: end`` closes a finished run.
Per-epoch validation / test metrics from the run's history log (the same shape as `metric` events).

schema.title: Response Runs History Api V1 Runs  Run Id  History Get

get.description: The experiment graph around a run: PA surrogate, DPD model and retry links with the checkpoint hashes used.
Latest bounded display snapshot; the worker alone computes the plots.

schema.title: Response Runs Live Api V1 Runs  Run Id  Live Get

get.description:
Page through logs/worker.log by byte offset (safe for very large logs).

A trailing line without newline is returned only once the run has finished
(while running it may still be written).
